name: Abdullah Khlaileh
title: Full-Stack Developer
heroIntro: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, responsive design, Flexbox, Grid, jQuery, UI/UX, modern layouts, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and interactive interfaces.
heroStack: C#, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, LINQ, SQL Server, database design, repository pattern, CRUD, authentication and authorization, MVC architecture, validation, and error handling.

footer.tagline: Let's work together to bring your ideas to life!

about:
With over a year and a half of hands-on experience in front-end development, I have built strong expertise in crafting responsive, structured, and user-centered web interfaces. My work reflects a deep understanding of page architecture, layout composition, and seamless adaptability across all screen sizes — from large displays to mobile devices. I specialize in developing dynamic and interactive web pages using modern JavaScript, along with HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, and advanced design principles. I have completed over 14 professional front-end projects.

In addition to my front-end expertise, I have completed a .NET back-end development course and worked on several practical projects applying C#, OOP principles, SQL Server, Entity Framework, LINQ, and MVC architecture. I gained hands-on experience in building back-end logic, database-driven applications, and implementing clean, maintainable code, supporting my transition toward a full-stack development role.

skills.title: UI/UX Design and Development
skills.description: Transforming ideas into visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces, with a focus on seamless user experience and easy navigation. Utilizing the latest technologies to ensure responsive, fast websites across all devices, while adhering to best practices in color schemes.

skills.title: Figma/PSD to Interactive Websites
skills.description: Converting Figma or Photoshop designs into fully functional, responsive websites. Ensuring compatibility across browsers and devices, while writing clean, maintainable code that guarantees high performance and long-term reliability.

skills.title: Template & Code Optimization
skills.description: Providing professional solutions for improving pre-built templates and existing websites, including code cleaning, bug fixing, and performance enhancement. This service ensures websites are more efficient, organized, and compliant with modern technical standards.

skills.title: Backend Architecture & Business Logic
skills.description: Developing structured and scalable server-side applications using C# and ASP.NET MVC, with a strong focus on clean architecture and separation of concerns. Designing and implementing business logic that supports real-world workflows, while applying MVC architecture and Repository Pattern to ensure maintainable code.

skills.title: Database Design & Data Management
skills.description: Designing and managing relational databases using SQL Server, including defining tables, relationships, and constraints to ensure data consistency. Implementing efficient CRUD operations using Entity Framework and LINQ, optimizing queries, and handling data transactions securely.

skills.title: Authentication, Authorization & Validation
skills.description: Implementing secure authentication and authorization systems to manage user access, roles, and permissions within web applications. Applying server-side data validation, exception handling, and security best practices to protect against common vulnerabilities.
